headline: Sensex and Nifty rebound as metals and financials lead gains while crude oil prices ease

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing crude oil prices provided relief to the domestic equity market.
Rally in metal, realty, and financial sector stocks supported benchmark indices.
OECD upgraded India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7.1%.
Strong buying in select individual stocks like Whirlpool, Ola Electric, and Bajaj Finance lifted market mood.
whatHappening: Sensex gained 299 points while Nifty 50 moved above the 23,400 mark to close at 2-week highs.
Whirlpool of India stock locked in a 20% upper circuit on promoter stake sale buzz.
Ola Electric Mobility surged 11% and PC Jeweller rose 6% in today's session.
ICRA noted daily fuel losses of ₹530 crore for OMCs due to recent crude oil price surges.
summary:
Indian equities rebounded today as Sensex surged 299 points and Nifty reclaimed the 23,400 level, reaching a two-week high.
The market rally was driven by strong gains in metal, financial, and realty stocks, alongside easing crude oil prices.
Investor sentiment was additionally buoyed by OECD raising India's growth projection for 2026-27 to 7.1%.
